claim_boundary: This locks a passive Lorentz/Yukawa nonlocal dielectric spectrum as a Route-2 V0 custom-solvent electrostatic control. It is not a cavity model, molecular liquid functional, dispersion model, standard-state convention, total solvation calculation, force/PES result, chemistry score, or accuracy claim.

literature.title: A Nonlocal Poisson-Fermi Model for Ionic Solvent
literature.role: The Lorentz/Yukawa permittivity form fixes epsilon(k) from static and optical limits plus a physical polarization-correlation length; its electrostatic state is variational.

literature.title: Simple Parameter-Free Bridge Functionals for Molecular Density Functional Theory
literature.role: A physically sourced dielectric response does not remove the separate need for a pressure/surface-tension-consistent cavity liquid functional.

literature.title: Spicing up continuum solvation models with SaLSA
literature.role: Nonlocal liquid response can be derived from a molecular susceptibility, but its reported total model contains a fitted dispersion contribution and is not imported into V0.

construction.name: route2-v0-lorentz-nonlocal-dielectric-v1
construction.orientational_scalar: For chi_or=(epsilon_0-epsilon_infinity)/(4 pi), minimize F_or[P;E] = integral[(|P|^2+lambda_s^2|grad P|^2)/(2 chi_or)-P dot E] d^3r. Its stationary P(k)=chi_or E(k)/(1+lambda_s^2|k|^2) yields the Lorentz spectrum on an epsilon_infinity electronic background.
construction.reaction_scalar: G_pol[rho]=1/2 integral rho V_reac[rho] d^3r, with V_reac(k)=4 pi (epsilon_s(k)^(-1)-1) rho(k)/|k|^2 for k!=0 and a neutral-source zero-mode gauge.
construction.derivative: delta G_pol/d rho = V_reac; real-even epsilon_s(k) makes the operator reciprocal and epsilon_s(k)>=1 makes G_pol nonpositive.
construction.correlation_length_rule: lambda_s is an independently sourced finite-wavevector dielectric/polarization correlation length. It cannot be inferred from epsilon_0, epsilon_infinity, a solvation error, a cavity radius, or a target molecule. If epsilon_0=epsilon_infinity, lambda_s is unidentifiable and must be absent.

source_contract.bulk_state_binding: A Route2V0BulkLiquidStateSource may hash-bind epsilon_0 and epsilon_infinity to independently sourced pure-liquid state records. The spectrum constructor must reject any mismatch.
required_before_physical_custom_electros: content-addressed finite-wavevector dielectric, ab-initio susceptibility, or independent polarization-correlation source for lambda_s
temperature, pressure, density, compressibility, and surface-tension state sources bound to the same solvent model
forbidden_inputs: development, confirmation, or blind solvation values

validation_sequence: Verify the exact k=0 static limit, high-wavevector optical limit, real-even reciprocal spectrum, and epsilon(k)>=1 passivity condition on the declared FFT grid.
Verify the same reaction scalar, finite-difference density derivative, reciprocal pairing, nonpositive polarization energy, translation covariance, and neutral-source zero-mode gauge.
Verify a bulk-state-bound source record and independent lambda_s source before calling the result a physical custom-solvent electrostatic diagnostic.
Keep the result separate from fixed-charge molecular-RISM inputs: optical epsilon and lambda_s do not construct C_ab(k), choose a closure, or create a molecular liquid functional.
Before any total-solvation calculation, join this response to one source-bound cavity, dispersion, liquid free-energy, and standard-state scalar and satisfy force/PES gates.

Only then run the immutable route2-v0-historical-freesolv10-regression-v1 panel including ethyl acetate, all 11-or-more solvent strata, disjoint confirmation, and an external blind set; every record must remain strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol.
decision_rule: A source, limit, correlation-length, reciprocity, passivity, scalar, force, historical-panel, multi-solvent, confirmation, or blind failure rejects the frozen candidate. It does not authorize a local dielectric substitution, a target-selected lambda_s, a post-hoc free-energy correction, a fitted cavity/dispersion parameter, post-training, fine-tuning, or per-record method selection.
